//: App project: `src/` + `tests/`, with the DOM libs and WITHOUT node types — a browser shell must not reach for a node builtin or `process`. The node side (the screenshot tooling, the build/test configs, the import-graph guard) lives in `tsconfig.tools.json`, which is the mirror image (node types, no DOM). Both are run by `pnpm run typecheck`, exactly like the split in `packages/*` and `extensions/vscode` (see docs/dev/vscode-extension.md §2.3).
//packages/ui: `@wing-agent/ui` is source-first (its `exports` points at `src/`), so an import pulls its modules in but never its ambient declarations — the explicit glob is the documented requirement of that package (same line in extensions/vscode/tsconfig.webview.json).
//exclude: The layering guard and the theme bridge's precondition test are node code (file system reads); tsconfig.tools.json owns every node-side file in this app.
